# Little Jem

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Nicknames:** Little Jem  <sub>[v4 c39 P21](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0021)</sub>; Jem  <sub>[v4 c39 P21](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0021)</sub>

## History

Little Jem is the newborn son of Anne and Gilbert Blythe. Susan Baker helps care for him at home while his parents are away visiting friends or dealing with emergencies.

_Sources: [v4 c39 P21](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0021)_
